title: trial started
description: The note an app writes in its own folder on its first start with no license, so its trial, a rule in mankit and not a license, knows when it started and on which install (ADR-L9): a Resource (ADR-S15), plain and unsigned. mankit's license check writes and reads it for every app. A rule no schema can say, as it needs today's date and the binary on disk: a missing, broken or future-dated note counts as none, as does one whose binary or fileTime differs from the running binary, so the app starts a fresh trial and writes a new note (ADR-L9). Several app versions read it at once: apiVersion, kind and metadata never change; spec may grow (ADR-S15).

apiVersion.description: The form the note is in, so a reader knows which schema it meets (ADR-S15, apiversion/v1/forms.yaml).

kind.description: Always TrialStarted, the kind of this note.

metadata.description: Which app's trial this is. It never changes in trial/v1 (ADR-S15).

id.description: The product id of the app whose trial this is, so a note copied into another app's folder is not taken as that app's.

spec.description: When and on which install the trial started. Open: a newer app may add fields here, and an older app accepts them (CT-RULE-4).

day.description: The day the trial started, an RFC 3339 date in UTC: the trial runs ADR-L9's trial length from it, its first day counted, so license-show.schema.json's trial.until is reckoned from it.

binary.description: The path of the app binary that started the trial, so the app tells the install that started it from a new one.

fileTime.description: That binary's file time (its last modification) when the trial started, RFC 3339. Installs write binaries fresh, so a reinstall or an update gives a new time, by which the app tells a new install from the one that started the trial.
